manualReasonBreakdown_stale_session.detail: False positive: assisted notes containing the word 'unambiguous' matched substring regex /ambiguous/ before word-boundary fix. After fix: 0.

priorBatchIsolation.note: Prior 191 are assisted+human-final cases. Unscoped classify places them in ALREADY_REVIEWED only — never in ELIGIBLE. UI previously rendered that unscoped ALREADY_REVIEWED beside stale 120/50 counts.

rootCause.ROOT_CAUSE: (1) IDENTITY_AMBIGUITY_WARNING substring match on 'unambiguous' caused 50 false manuals; fixed with word boundaries. (2) Bulk preview API used unscoped classifyAssistedBulkApproval(), so UI showed ALREADY_REVIEWED=191 from prior pool. (3) Stale browser/server session could retain 120/50 until reload after fix.

scope.SCOPE_NOTE: Scoped to latest import / active review batch — prior assisted+reviewed pools excluded from eligibility counts
